controlled_sorrow.label: Controlled Sorrow
controlled_sorrow.face: tears streaming silently, eyes open, composed expression, deep but restrained emotion
controlled_sorrow.body: still, upright, holding composure, slight tension in shoulders
controlled_sorrow.vibe: the weight is internal, not performative, strength holding back an ocean
controlled_sorrow.do_not: open mouth sobbing, collapsed posture, melodramatic

loud_lament.label: Loud Lament
loud_lament.face: mouth open in wail, tears streaming, face contorted with grief, eyes red
loud_lament.body: shoulders shaking, hands helpless at sides or raised in lament
loud_lament.do_not: silent tears, calm face, controlled posture

agony_collapse.label: Agony / Collapse
agony_collapse.face: face-down in dirt, mouth open in scream, tears mixing with dust, blood-tinged sweat
agony_collapse.body: prostrate, fully collapsed, arms forward, fingers gripping ground
agony_collapse.vibe: the darkest moment, alone, abandonment, krauges ischyras — strong crying
agony_collapse.do_not: kneeling prayer, calm submission, clean composed suffering

compassionate_presence.label: Compassionate Presence
compassionate_presence.face: gentle eyes, slight warm expression, fully present, no hurry
compassionate_presence.body: seated or standing at eye level, one hand extended or resting gently
compassionate_presence.vibe: I am here, I see you, no fixing just being
compassionate_presence.do_not: preaching posture, hand raised in blessing, distant holy expression

grief_active.label: Active Grief
grief_active.face: anguished, almost accusing, holding in words for days, face of confrontation
grief_active.body: one hand pressed to chest, other reaching forward, standing, active
grief_active.vibe: Martha's grief — the one who cannot sit still
grief_active.do_not: passive crying, collapsed posture, silent tears

grief_collapsed.label: Collapsed Grief
grief_collapsed.face: hidden or downcast, hair covering face, expression of being emptied out
grief_collapsed.body: sitting on floor against wall, head down, arms limp, inward and still
grief_collapsed.vibe: Mary's grief — the one who has no words left

awe_wonder.label: Awe / Wonder
awe_wonder.face: eyes wide, mouth slightly open, the moment of impossible becoming real
awe_wonder.body: still, frozen in the moment, mid-breath
awe_wonder.vibe: Lazarus walking out, resurrection, something that cannot be happening

celebration_foreboding.label: Celebration with Foreboding
celebration_foreboding.face: crowd joyful, Jesus's face calm and distant, knowing
celebration_foreboding.body: crowd waving palms, Jesus riding donkey, stillness amid chaos
celebration_foreboding.vibe: Palm Sunday — the celebration that misses the point
celebration_foreboding.do_not: Jesus celebrating, Jesus smiling broadly, triumphant king pose

quiet_presence.label: Quiet Presence
quiet_presence.vibe: the moment after the storm, dawn light, stillness

dread_isolation.label: Dread / Isolation
dread_isolation.face: weight of what is coming, heavy brow, shadow across eyes
dread_isolation.body: hunched, alone, carrying weight, leaning forward under burden
dread_isolation.vibe: Gethsemane before the prayer, the weight before the fall

resolution_peace.label: Resolution / Peace
resolution_peace.face: calm, resolved, slight peace, the exhale after holding breath
resolution_peace.vibe: the ending that opens to something new, unanswered questions at peace
